runtimes.riichi:
sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pneuma.riichi-mahjong
features: {}
abilities: {}
tools:
  _reset_hand:
    description: Package-owned reset hand.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: actor.game
        value:
          hand: []
          melds: []
          discards: []
          riichi: false
          double_riichi: false
          ippatsu: false
          temporary_furiten: false
          riichi_furiten: false
          draw_count: 0
          last_draw: null
          rinshan: false
          forbidden_discards: []
          choices: []
          decision_actions: []
          riichi_waits: []
          pao_dragon: null
          pao_wind: null
          revealed: false
    narrative: {}
  _draw:
    description: Package-owned draw.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - require:
        condition: len(state.live) > 0
        error: The live wall is empty.
    - set:
        field: _tile
        value: state.live[0]
    - set:
        field: _hand
        value: joined(actor.game.hand, one(_tile))
    - set:
        field: actor.game.hand
        value: _hand
    - set:
        field: actor.game.last_draw
        value: _tile
    - set:
        field: actor.game.draw_count
        value: actor.game.draw_count + 1
    - set:
        field: actor.game.temporary_furiten
        value: false
    - set:
        field: actor.game.rinshan
        value: false
    - set:
        field: state.live
        value: portion(state.live, 1, len(state.live))
    - set:
        field: state.phase
        value: '"discard"'
    narrative: {}
  _new_hand:
    description: Package-owned new hand.
    parameters: []
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - shuffle:
        collection: indices(136)
      store_as: _wall
    - set:
        field: state.pending_riichi
        value: null
    - set:
        field: state.pending_kan
        value: null
    - set:
        field: state.ron_seats
        value: []
    - set:
        field: state.kan_owners
        value: []
    - set:
        field: state.abort_after_discard
        value: false
    - set:
        field: state.result
        value: null
    - set:
        field: state.winners
        value: []
    - set:
        field: state.dead
        value: portion(_wall, 122, 136)
    - set:
        field: state.live
        value: portion(_wall, 52, 122)
    - set:
        field: state.kan_count
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: state.kan_pending_dora
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: state.any_call
        value: false
    - set:
        field: state.last_discard
        value: null
    - set:
        field: state.responses
        value: []
    - set:
        field: state.pending_calls
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _seat_ids
        value: state.seats
    - set:
        field: _index
        value: 0
    - for_each:
        collection: _seat_ids
        as: _seat
        do:
        - call: _reset_hand
          params:
            actor: '{_seat}'
        - call: _deal_seat
          params:
            actor: '{_seat}'
            tiles: '{_wall}'
            offset: '{_index}'
        - set:
            field: _index
            value: _index + 1
    - set:
        field: state.actor
        value: state.seats[state.dealer]
    - call: _draw
      params:
        actor: '{state.actor}'
    narrative: {}
  _deal_seat:
    description: Package-owned deal seat.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: tiles
      type: array
      items:
        type: integer
    - name: offset
      type: integer
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: actor.game.hand
        value: portion(tiles, offset * 13, (offset + 1) * 13)
    narrative: {}
  _reset_score:
    description: Package-owned reset score.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: actor.score
        value: 25000
    narrative: {}
  _refresh:
    description: Package-owned refresh.
    parameters: []
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - call: _forced_responses
      params: {}
    - set:
        field: state.sequence
        value: state.sequence + 1
    - call: _options
      params:
        actor: '{state.actor}'
      export_context:
        _choices: _choices
    - require:
        condition: len(_choices) <= 256
        error: The current action set exceeds its bound.
    - shuffle:
        collection: indices(256)
      store_as: _opaque_indices
    - set:
        field: _numbered
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _choice_ids
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _index
        value: 0
    - for_each:
        collection: _choices
        as: _choice
        do:
        - set:
            field: _id
            value: '''choice:'' + text(state.sequence) + '':'' + text(_opaque_indices[_index])'
        - set:
            field: _row
            value:
              id: _id
        - set:
            field: _row
            value: merge(_choice, _row)
        - list_push:
            list: _numbered
            value: _row
        - list_push:
            list: _choice_ids
            value: _id
        - set:
            field: _index
            value: _index + 1
    - set:
        field: state.choices
        value: _numbered
    - set:
        field: state.choice_ids
        value: _choice_ids
    - call: _actor_choices
      params:
        actor: '{state.actor}'
        choices: '{_numbered}'
    - set:
        field: _areas
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _statuses
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _seat_ids
        value: state.seats
    - for_each:
        collection: _seat_ids
        as: _seat
        do:
        - call: _seat_table
          params:
            actor: '{_seat}'
          export_context:
            _area: _area
            _status: _status
        - list_push:
            list: _areas
            value: _area
        - list_push:
            list: _statuses
            value: _status
    - call: _center_table
      params: {}
      export_context:
        _center: _center
    - list_push:
        list: _areas
        value: _center
    - list_push:
        list: _statuses
        value:
          label: '"Round"'
          value: definitions.winds[min(state.round_wind, 2)] + ' ' + text(state.dealer
            + 1)
    - list_push:
        list: _statuses
        value:
          label: '"Honba"'
          value: text(state.honba)
    - list_push:
        list: _statuses
        value:
          label: '"Riichi sticks"'
          value: text(state.sticks)
    - list_push:
        list: _statuses
        value:
          label: '"Live wall"'
          value: text(len(state.live))
    - set:
        field: state.table
        value:
          format: 1
          layout: '"four_sided"'
          title: '"Riichi Mahjong"'
          status: _statuses
          areas: _areas
    - set:
        field: _records
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _seats
        value: state.seats
    - for_each:
        collection: _seats
        as: _seat
        do:
        - call: _public_seat
          params:
            actor: '{_seat}'
          export_context:
            _public_seat: _public_seat
        - list_push:
            list: _records
            value: _public_seat
    - call: _actor_public_table
      params:
        actor: '{state.actor}'
        records: '{_records}'
    narrative: {}
  _actor_choices:
    description: Package-owned actor choices.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: choices
      type: array
      items:
        type: object
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: actor.game.choices
        value: choices
    - set:
        field: _decisions
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: choices
        as: _choice
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _decisions
            value:
              id: _choice.id
              label: _choice.label
              operation: '"take_action"'
              arguments:
                choice: _choice.id
    - set:
        field: actor.game.decision_actions
        value: _decisions
    narrative: {}
  _seat_table:
    description: Package-owned seat table.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _pieces
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _tiles
        value: ordered(actor.game.hand)
    - for_each:
        collection: _tiles
        as: _tile
        do:
        - set:
            field: _face
            value: definitions.tiles[_tile]
        - set:
            field: _piece
            value:
              id: '''tile:'' + text(_tile)'
              label: _face.label
              face: _face.face
              flags: []
        - condition:
            condition: _face.red
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value: merge(_piece, definitions.red_presentation)
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: actor.game.last_draw == _tile
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _drawn
                value:
                  detail: '"Drawn tile"'
                  emphasis: '"accent"'
                  flags:
                  - '"drawn"'
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value: merge(_piece, _drawn)
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _actor_id == state.actor and actor.control == 'player'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _choices
                value: state.choices
            - for_each:
                collection: _choices
                as: _choice
                do:
                - condition:
                    condition: _choice.op == 'discard' and _choice.tiles[0] == _tile
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _action
                        value:
                          id: _choice.id
                          action_id: '"play"'
                    - set:
                        field: _piece
                        value: merge(_piece, _action)
                    on_false: []
            on_false: []
        - list_push:
            list: _pieces
            value: _piece
    - set:
        field: _hand
        value:
          id: '"hand"'
          label: '"Hand"'
          role: '"rack"'
          visibility: '"owner"'
          owner: _actor_id
          show_count: true
          pieces: _pieces
    - condition:
        condition: actor.control == 'player'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _hand_owner
            value:
              owner: actor.participant_id
        - set:
            field: _hand
            value: merge(_hand, _hand_owner)
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _pieces
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _discards
        value: actor.game.discards
    - for_each:
        collection: _discards
        as: _discard
        do:
        - set:
            field: _face
            value: definitions.tiles[_discard.tile]
        - list_push:
            list: _pieces
            value:
              id: '''discard:'' + text(_discard.tile)'
              label: _face.label
    - set:
        field: _discard_group
        value:
          id: '"discards"'
          label: '"Discards"'
          visibility: '"public"'
          pieces: _pieces
    - set:
        field: _area
        value:
          id: _actor_id
          label: actor.name
          position: definitions.positions[actor.seat]
          groups:
          - _hand
          - _discard_group
    - set:
        field: _status
        value:
          label: actor.name
          value: text(actor.score)
    - condition:
        condition: actor.game.revealed
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _visible
            value:
              visibility: '"public"'
        - set:
            field: _hand
            value: merge(_hand, _visible)
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: actor.game.revealed and state.result != null and state.result.kind
          == 'win' and actor.seat in state.winners and not state.win_tsumo
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _winning_piece
            value:
              id: '"winning-discard"'
              label: definitions.tiles[state.winning_tile].label
              face: definitions.tiles[state.winning_tile].face
              flags: []
              detail: '"Winning discard"'
              emphasis: '"accent"'
        - set:
            field: _complete_hand
            value:
              pieces: joined(_hand.pieces, one(_winning_piece))
        - set:
            field: _hand
            value: merge(_hand, _complete_hand)
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _pieces
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _riichi_marker
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _discards
        value: actor.game.discards
    - for_each:
        collection: _discards
        as: _discard
        do:
        - set:
            field: _piece
            value:
              id: '''discard:'' + text(_discard.tile)'
              label: definitions.tiles[_discard.tile].label
              face: definitions.tiles[_discard.tile].face
              flags: []
        - condition:
            condition: definitions.tiles[_discard.tile].red
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value: merge(_piece, definitions.red_presentation)
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _discard.riichi
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _riichi_marker
                value: true
            - set:
                field: _flag
                value:
                  detail: '"Riichi declaration"'
                  emphasis: '"accent"'
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value: merge(_piece, _flag)
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _discard.claimed
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _flag
                value:
                  detail: '"Called into a meld"'
                  emphasis: '"muted"'
                  flags:
                  - '"claimed"'
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value: merge(_piece, _flag)
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _riichi_marker and not _discard.claimed
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _flag
                value:
                  flags:
                  - '"sideways"'
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value: merge(_piece, _flag)
            - set:
                field: _riichi_marker
                value: false
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: state.last_discard != null and _discard.tile == state.last_discard.tile
              and not _discard.claimed
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _flag
                value:
                  emphasis: '"accent"'
                  flags: joined(_piece.flags, one('latest'))
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value: merge(_piece, _flag)
            on_false: []
        - list_push:
            list: _pieces
            value: _piece
    - set:
        field: _discard_group
        value:
          id: '"discards"'
          label: '"Discards"'
          role: '"pond"'
          visibility: '"public"'
          pieces: _pieces
    - set:
        field: _regular
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _drawn_pieces
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _rack_pieces
        value: _hand.pieces
    - for_each:
        collection: _rack_pieces
        as: _rack_piece
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: '''drawn'' in _rack_piece.flags'
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _drawn_pieces
                value: _rack_piece
            on_false:
            - list_push:
                list: _regular
                value: _rack_piece
    - set:
        field: _complete_hand
        value:
          pieces: joined(_regular, _drawn_pieces)
    - set:
        field: _hand
        value: merge(_hand, _complete_hand)
    - set:
        field: _groups
        value:
        - _hand
        - _discard_group
    - set:
        field: _melds
        value: actor.game.melds
    - set:
        field: _index
        value: 0
    - for_each:
        collection: _melds
        as: _meld
        do:
        - set:
            field: _pieces
            value: []
        - set:
            field: _tiles
            value: ordered(_meld.tiles)
        - set:
            field: _called
            value: -1
        - set:
            field: _added
            value: -1
        - set:
            field: _offset
            value: (_meld.source_seat - actor.seat + 4) % 4
        - condition:
            condition: _meld.opened
            on_true:
            - condition:
                condition: 'true'
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _argument_actor
                    value: state.seats[_meld.source_seat]
                - call: _discard_history
                  params:
                    actor: '{_argument_actor}'
                  export_context:
                    _source_discards: _source_discards
                on_false: []
            - for_each:
                collection: _source_discards
                as: _source_discard
                do:
                - condition:
                    condition: _source_discard.claimed and _source_discard.tile in
                      _meld.tiles
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _called
                        value: _source_discard.tile
                    on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _meld.quad and _called != _meld.tiles[3]
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _added
                    value: _meld.tiles[3]
                on_false: []
            on_false: []
        - set:
            field: _normal
            value: []
        - for_each:
            collection: _tiles
            as: _normal_tile
            do:
            - condition:
                condition: _normal_tile != _called and _normal_tile != _added
                on_true:
                - list_push:
                    list: _normal
                    value: _normal_tile
                on_false: []
        - set:
            field: _ordered
            value: _tiles
        - condition:
            condition: not _meld.opened and definitions.tiles[_tiles[0]].red
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _ordered
                value:
                - _tiles[1]
                - _tiles[0]
                - _tiles[2]
                - _tiles[3]
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _called >= 0
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _slot
                value: 0
            - condition:
                condition: _offset == 1
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _slot
                    value: len(_normal)
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _offset == 2
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _slot
                    value: 1
                on_false: []
            - set:
                field: _ordered
                value: joined(joined(portion(_normal, 0, _slot), one(_called)), portion(_normal,
                  _slot, len(_normal)))
            on_false: []
        - for_each:
            collection: _ordered
            as: _tile
            do:
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value:
                  id: '''meld:'' + text(_tile)'
                  label: definitions.tiles[_tile].label
                  face: definitions.tiles[_tile].face
                  flags: []
            - condition:
                condition: _tile == _called
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _flag
                    value:
                      flags:
                      - '"sideways"'
                - set:
                    field: _piece
                    value: merge(_piece, _flag)
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: not _meld.opened and (_tile == _ordered[0] or _tile ==
                  _ordered[3])
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _flag
                    value:
                      flags:
                      - '"back"'
                - set:
                    field: _piece
                    value: merge(_piece, _flag)
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: definitions.tiles[_tile].red
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _piece
                    value: merge(_piece, definitions.red_presentation)
                on_false: []
            - list_push:
                list: _pieces
                value: _piece
            - condition:
                condition: _tile == _called and _added >= 0
                on_true:
                - list_push:
                    list: _pieces
                    value:
                      id: '''meld:'' + text(_added)'
                      label: definitions.tiles[_added].label
                      face: definitions.tiles[_added].face
                      flags:
                      - '"stacked"'
                on_false: []
        - set:
            field: _label
            value: '"Pon"'
        - condition:
            condition: _meld.form == 'sequence'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _label
                value: '"Chi"'
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _meld.quad
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _label
                value: '"Open kan"'
            - condition:
                condition: not _meld.opened
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _label
                    value: '"Concealed kan"'
                on_false: []
            on_false: []
        - list_push:
            list: _groups
            value:
              id: '''meld:'' + text(_index)'
              label: _label
              role: '"meld"'
              source: definitions.call_sources[_offset]
              visibility: '"public"'
              pieces: _pieces
        - set:
            field: _index
            value: _index + 1
    - set:
        field: _seat_label
        value: actor.name + ' / ' + definitions.seat_winds[(actor.seat - state.dealer
          + 4) % 4]
    - condition:
        condition: actor.game.riichi
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _seat_label
            value: _seat_label + ' / Riichi'
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: state.result != null and state.result.kind == 'draw'
        on_true:
        - condition:
            condition: actor.game.revealed
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _seat_label
                value: _seat_label + ' / Tenpai'
            on_false:
            - set:
                field: _seat_label
                value: _seat_label + ' / Noten'
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _area
        value:
          id: _actor_id
          label: _seat_label
          position: definitions.positions[actor.seat]
          badge: definitions.wind_glyphs[(actor.seat - state.dealer + 4) % 4]
          score: text(actor.score)
          active: _actor_id == state.actor and not state.finished
          groups: _groups
    narrative: {}
  _center_table:
    description: Package-owned center table.
    parameters: []
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _dora
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _visible_indicators
        value: 1 + state.kan_count - state.kan_pending_dora
    - condition:
        condition: state.phase == 'kan_response' and state.pending_kan.op == 'ankan'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _visible_indicators
            value: _visible_indicators + 1
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _indexes
        value: indices(_visible_indicators)
    - for_each:
        collection: _indexes
        as: _index
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _dora
            value:
              id: '''dora:'' + text(_index)'
              label: definitions.tiles[state.dead[4 + _index * 2]].label
              face: definitions.tiles[state.dead[4 + _index * 2]].face
    - call: _choice_table
      params:
        actor: '{state.actor}'
      export_context:
        _options: _options
        _turn: _turn
    - set:
        field: _info
        value:
        - id: '"message"'
          label: state.message
    - condition:
        condition: state.finished and state.match_result != null
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _standings
            value: state.match_result.standings
        - for_each:
            collection: _standings
            as: _standing
            do:
            - list_push:
                list: _info
                value:
                  id: '''place:'' + text(_standing.seat)'
                  label: 'text(_standing.rank) + ''. '' + _standing.name + '': ''
                    + text(_standing.points)'
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: state.pending_kan != null and state.phase == 'kan_response'
        on_true:
        - list_push:
            list: _info
            value:
              id: '"kan"'
              label: '''Kan declared: '' + definitions.tiles[state.last_discard.tile].label'
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: state.result != null and state.result.kind == 'win'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _wins
            value: state.result.winners
        - for_each:
            collection: _wins
            as: _win

        field: _patterns

    - for_each:

        do:
        - set:
            field: _groups
            value: []
        - for_each:
            collection: _partition
            as: _pattern
            do:
            - condition:
                condition: _pattern < 34
                on_true:
                - list_push:
                    list: _groups
                    value:
                      form: '"pair"'
                      base: _pattern
                      opened: false
                      quad: false
                on_false:
                - condition:
                    condition: _pattern < 68
                    on_true:
                    - list_push:
                        list: _groups
                        value:
                          form: '"triplet"'
                          base: _pattern - 34
                          opened: false
                          quad: false
                    on_false:
                    - list_push:
                        list: _groups
                        value:
                          form: '"sequence"'
                          base: definitions.sequence_starts[_pattern - 68]
                          opened: false
                          quad: false
        - set:
            field: _closed_count
            value: len(_groups)
        - set:
            field: _melds
            value: actor.game.melds
        - for_each:
            collection: _melds

                      or (_candidate.yakuman_units == _score.yakuman_units and _candidate.han
                      > _score.han)))))
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _score
                        value: _candidate
                    on_false: []

                    - set:

                        value: _distinct_terminals + 1

                    - set:
                        field: _only_terminals
                        value: false
                on_false: []
        - set:

        - condition:

            - set:

                value: '"seven_pairs"'
            on_false: []
        - condition:

            - set:
                field: _shape
                value: '"orphans"'
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _shape != null
            on_true:
            - call: _score_shape
              params:
                actor: '{_actor_id}'
                winning_tile: '{winning_tile}'
                is_tsumo: '{is_tsumo}'
                win_source: '{win_source}'
                groups: []
                placement: -1
                shape: '{_shape}'
              export_context:
                _candidate: _candidate
            - condition:
                condition: (_candidate.valid and not _score.valid) or (_candidate.valid
                  == _score.valid and (_candidate.total > _score.total or (_candidate.total
                  == _score.total and (_candidate.yakuman_units > _score.yakuman_units
                  or (_candidate.yakuman_units == _score.yakuman_units and _candidate.han
                  > _score.han)))))
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _score
                    value: _candidate
                on_false: []
            on_false: []

  _score_shape:
    description: Package-owned score shape.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: winning_tile
      type: integer
    - name: is_tsumo
      type: boolean
    - name: win_source
      type: string
    - name: groups
      type: array
      items:
        type: object
    - name: placement
      type: integer
    - name: shape
      type: string

    effects:
    - set:
        field: _closed
        value: true
    - set:
        field: _tiles
        value: actor.game.hand
    - condition:
        condition: not is_tsumo
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _tiles
            value: joined(_tiles, one(winning_tile))
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _melds
        value: actor.game.melds
    - for_each:
        collection: _melds
        as: _meld
        do:
        - set:
            field: _tiles
            value: joined(_tiles, _meld.tiles)

        value: []

        field: _suits
        value: []

        field: _red
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _all_simple
        value: true
    - set:
        field: _all_honors
        value: true
    - set:
        field: _all_terminals
        value: true
    - set:
        field: _all_outside
        value: true
    - set:
        field: _has_honors
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _all_green
        value: true
    - for_each:
        collection: _tiles
        as: _tile
        do:
        - set:
            field: _face
            value: definitions.tiles[_tile]
        - list_push:
            list: _kinds
            value: _face.kind
        - condition:
            condition: _face.red
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _red
                value: _red + 1
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _face.kind >= 27
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _all_simple
                value: false
            - set:
                field: _all_terminals
                value: false
            - set:
                field: _has_honors
                value: true
            on_false:
            - set:
                field: _all_honors
                value: false
            - set:
                field: _suit
                value: _face.kind // 9
            - condition:
                condition: _suit not in _suits
                on_true:
                - list_push:
                    list: _suits
                    value: _suit
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _face.kind % 9 == 0 or _face.kind % 9 == 8
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _all_simple
                    value: false
                on_false:
                - set:
                    field: _all_terminals
                    value: false
                - set:
                    field: _all_outside

            - set:
                field: _all_green
                value: false

    - set:
        field: _round_wind
        value: 27 + state.round_wind

        field: _winning_kind
        value: definitions.tiles[winning_tile].kind
    - set:

        value: []
    - set:
        field: _triplets
        value: []
    - set:

    - set:

    - set:
        field: _winds

    - set:
        field: _yakuhai

    - set:

        value: -1
    - set:
        field: _meld_fu
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _pair_fu
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _wait_fu
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _outside_groups

    - set:
        field: _index

                - set:

                        field: _concealed_sets
                        value: _concealed_sets + 1
                    on_false: []
                - set:
                    field: _fu
                    value: 2
                - condition:
                    condition: not _open
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _fu
                        value: _fu * 2
                    on_false: []
                - condition:
                    condition: _group.quad
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _fu
                        value: _fu * 4
                    - set:
                        field: _quads
                        value: _quads + 1
                    on_false: []
                - condition:

                    - set:

                    on_false: []
                - set:
                    field: _meld_fu
                    value: _meld_fu + _fu

                    - set:
                        field: _yakuhai

                - condition:
                    condition: _group.base == _round_wind

                    - set:
                        field: _yakuhai
                        value: _yakuhai + 1

        - condition:

                    field: _pure_nine_gates

        field: _han

                - condition:
                    condition: len(_matching) == 4
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _allowed
                        value: true
                    - condition:
                        condition: actor.game.riichi
                        on_true:
                        - call: _riichi_kan
                          params:
                            actor: '{_actor_id}'
                            kind: '{_kind}'
                            tiles: '{_matching}'
                          export_context:
                            _allowed: _allowed
                        on_false: []
                    - condition:
                        condition: _allowed
                        on_true:
                        - list_push:
                            list: _choices
                            value:
                              op: '"ankan"'
                              tiles: _matching
                              base: _kind
                              label: '''Concealed kan: '' + definitions.tiles[_matching[0]].label'
                        on_false: []
                    on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: not actor.game.riichi
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _melds
                    value: actor.game.melds
                - set:
                    field: _index
                    value: 0
                - for_each:
                    collection: _melds
                    as: _meld
                    do:
                    - condition:
                        condition: _meld.form == 'triplet' and not _meld.quad and
                          _meld.opened
                        on_true:
                        - call: _matching
                          params:
                            actor: '{_actor_id}'
                            kind: '{_meld.base}'
                          export_context:
                            _matching: _matching
                        - for_each:
                            collection: _matching
                            as: _tile
                            do:
                            - list_push:
                                list: _choices
                                value:
                                  op: '"kakan"'
                                  tiles:
                                  - _tile
                                  base: _meld.base
                                  meld_index: _index
                                  label: '''Added kan: '' + definitions.tiles[_tile].label'
                        on_false: []
                    - set:
                        field: _index
                        value: _index + 1
                on_false: []
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: actor.game.draw_count == 1 and len(actor.game.discards) ==
              0 and not state.any_call
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _terminals
                value: []
            - set:
                field: _hand
                value: actor.game.hand
            - for_each:
                collection: _hand
                as: _tile
                do:
                - condition:
                    condition: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind in definitions.terminals
                      and definitions.tiles[_tile].kind not in _terminals
                    on_true:
                    - list_push:
                        list: _terminals
                        value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
                    on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: len(_terminals) >= 9
                on_true:
                - list_push:
                    list: _choices
                    value:
                      op: '"abort_nine"'
                      label: '"Nine terminals: abort hand"'
                      tiles: []
                on_false: []
            on_false: []
        on_false: []
    narrative: {}
  _riichi_kan:
    description: Package-owned riichi kan.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: kind
      type: integer
    - name: tiles
      type: array
      items:
        type: integer
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _allowed
        value: definitions.tiles[actor.game.last_draw].kind == kind
    - set:
        field: _wait_kinds
        value: actor.game.riichi_waits
    - set:
        field: _remaining
        value: without(actor.game.hand, tiles)
    - set:
        field: _remaining_kinds
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _remaining
        as: _tile
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _remaining_kinds
            value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _after
        value: completions(_remaining_kinds, definitions.patterns, definitions.group_sizes[len(actor.game.melds)
          + 1], indices(34))
    - set:
        field: _owned_kinds
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _owned_tiles
        value: actor.game.hand
    - for_each:
        collection: _owned_tiles
        as: _tile
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _owned_kinds
            value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _melds
        value: actor.game.melds
    - for_each:
        collection: _melds
        as: _meld
        do:
        - set:
            field: _meld_tiles
            value: _meld.tiles
        - for_each:
            collection: _meld_tiles
            as: _tile
            do:
            - list_push:
                list: _owned_kinds
                value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _filtered_after
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _after
        as: _wait_kind
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: occurrences(_owned_kinds, _wait_kind) < 4
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _filtered_after
                value: _wait_kind
            on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: len(_filtered_after) != len(actor.game.riichi_waits)
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _allowed
            value: false
        on_false: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _filtered_after
        as: _wait_kind
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: _wait_kind not in actor.game.riichi_waits
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _allowed
                value: false
            on_false: []
    narrative: {}
  _response_options:
    description: Package-owned response options.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _choices
        value:
        - op: '"pass"'
          label: '"Pass"'
          tiles: []
    - set:
        field: _tile
        value: state.last_discard.tile
    - set:
        field: _kind
        value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - call: _waits
      params:
        actor: '{_actor_id}'
        tiles: '{actor.game.hand}'
      export_context:
        _waits: _waits
    - set:
        field: _furiten
        value: actor.game.temporary_furiten or actor.game.riichi_furiten
    - set:
        field: _discards
        value: actor.game.discards
    - for_each:
        collection: _discards
        as: _discard
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: definitions.tiles[_discard.tile].kind in _waits
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _furiten
                value: true
            on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: _kind in _waits and not _furiten
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _source
            value: '"discard"'
        - condition:
            condition: state.last_discard.rinshan == true
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _source
                value: '"rinshan_discard"'
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: state.phase == 'kan_response'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _source
                value: '"closed_kan"'
            - condition:
                condition: state.pending_kan.op == 'kakan'
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _source
                    value: '"added_kan"'
                on_false: []
            on_false: []
        - call: _score_hand
          params:
            actor: '{_actor_id}'
            winning_tile: '{_tile}'
            is_tsumo: false
            win_source: '{_source}'
          export_context:
            _score: _score
        - condition:
            condition: _score.valid and (_source != 'closed_kan' or _score.shape ==
              'orphans')
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _choices
                value:
                  op: '"ron"'
                  label: '"Ron"'
                  tiles: []
            on_false: []
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: state.phase == 'response' and not actor.game.riichi and len(state.live)
          > 0 and not state.abort_after_discard
        on_true:
        - call: _matching
          params:
            actor: '{_actor_id}'
            kind: '{_kind}'
          export_context:
            _matching: _matching
        - set:
            field: _copies
            value: _matching
        - set:
            field: _indexes
            value: indices(len(_copies))
        - for_each:
            collection: _indexes
            as: _a
            do:
            - for_each:
                collection: _indexes
                as: _b
                do:
                - condition:
                    condition: _a < _b
                    on_true:
                    - condition:
                        condition: 'true'
                        on_true:
                        - set:
                            field: _argument_tiles
                            value: joined(one(_copies[_a]), one(_copies[_b]))
                        - call: _call_option
                          params:
                            actor: '{_actor_id}'
                            op: pon
                            tiles: '{_argument_tiles}'
                            base: '{_kind}'
                          export_context:
                            _option: _option
                        on_false: []
                    - condition:
                        condition: _option != null
                        on_true:
                        - list_push:
                            list: _choices
                            value: _option
                        on_false: []
                    on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: len(_copies) == 3 and state.kan_count < 4
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _choices
                value:
                  op: '"minkan"'
                  tiles: _copies
                  base: _kind
                  label: '"Open kan"'
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: actor.seat == (state.last_discard.seat + 1) % 4 and _kind <
              27
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _offsets
                value:
                - 0
                - 1
                - 2
            - for_each:
                collection: _offsets
                as: _offset
                do:
                - set:
                    field: _base
                    value: _kind - _offset
                - condition:
                    condition: _base >= 0 and _base // 9 == _kind // 9 and _base %
                      9 <= 6
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _needed
                        value: without(joined(one(_base), joined(one(_base + 1), one(_base
                          + 2))), one(_kind))
                    - condition:
                        condition: 'true'
                        on_true:
                        - set:
                            field: _argument_kind
                            value: _needed[0]
                        - call: _matching
                          params:
                            actor: '{_actor_id}'
                            kind: '{_argument_kind}'
                          export_context:
                            _matching: _matching
                        on_false: []
                    - set:
                        field: _first
                        value: _matching
                    - condition:
                        condition: 'true'
                        on_true:
                        - set:
                            field: _argument_kind
                            value: _needed[1]
                        - call: _matching
                          params:
                            actor: '{_actor_id}'
                            kind: '{_argument_kind}'
                          export_context:
                            _matching: _matching
                        on_false: []
                    - set:
                        field: _second
                        value: _matching
                    - for_each:
                        collection: _first
                        as: _a
                        do:
                        - for_each:
                            collection: _second
                            as: _b
                            do:
                            - condition:
                                condition: 'true'
                                on_true:
                                - set:
                                    field: _argument_tiles
                                    value: joined(one(_a), one(_b))
                                - call: _call_option
                                  params:
                                    actor: '{_actor_id}'
                                    op: chi
                                    tiles: '{_argument_tiles}'
                                    base: '{_base}'
                                  export_context:
                                    _option: _option
                                on_false: []
                            - condition:
                                condition: _option != null
                                on_true:
                                - list_push:
                                    list: _choices
                                    value: _option
                                on_false: []
                    on_false: []
            on_false: []
        on_false: []
    narrative: {}
  _call_option:
    description: Package-owned call option.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: op
      type: string
    - name: tiles
      type: array
      items:
        type: integer
    - name: base
      type: integer
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _called
        value: definitions.tiles[state.last_discard.tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _forbidden
        value: one(_called)
    - condition:
        condition: op == 'chi'
        on_true:
        - condition:
            condition: _called == base and base % 9 < 6
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _forbidden
                value: base + 3
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _called == base + 2 and base % 9 > 0
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _forbidden
                value: base - 1
            on_false: []
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _legal_discard
        value: false
    - set:
        field: _remaining
        value: without(actor.game.hand, tiles)
    - for_each:
        collection: _remaining
        as: _tile
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind not in _forbidden
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _legal_discard
                value: true
            on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _option
        value: null
    - condition:
        condition: _legal_discard
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _option
            value:
              op: op
              tiles: tiles
              base: base
              forbidden: _forbidden
              label: 'op + '': '' + definitions.tiles[tiles[0]].label + '' '' + definitions.tiles[tiles[1]].label'
        on_false: []
    narrative: {}
  _begin_responses:
    description: Package-owned begin responses.
    parameters:
    - name: seat
      type: integer
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: state.pending_calls
        value: []
    - set:
        field: state.ron_seats
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _responders
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _steps
        value:
        - 1
        - 2
        - 3
    - for_each:
        collection: _steps
        as: _step
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _responders
            value: state.seats[(seat + _step) % 4]
    - set:
        field: state.responders
        value: _responders
    - set:
        field: state.actor
        value: _responders[0]
    narrative: {}
  _discard:
    description: Package-owned discard.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: selected
      type: object
      from_state: state.action_selection
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _tile
        value: selected.tiles[0]
    - set:
        field: actor.game.hand
        value: without(actor.game.hand, one(_tile))
    - set:
        field: actor.game.ippatsu
        value: false
    - condition:
        condition: selected.op == 'riichi'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: state.pending_riichi
            value: actor.seat
        - set:
            field: actor.game.riichi_waits
            value: selected.waits
        - set:
            field: actor.game.double_riichi
            value: len(actor.game.discards) == 0 and not state.any_call
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _discards
        value: actor.game.discards
    - list_push:
        list: _discards
        value:
          tile: _tile
          claimed: false
          riichi: selected.op == 'riichi'
    - set:
        field: actor.game.discards
        value: _discards
    - set:
        field: actor.game.forbidden_discards
        value: []
    - set:
        field: actor.game.last_draw
        value: null
    - set:
        field: state.last_discard
        value:
          tile: _tile
          seat: actor.seat
          rinshan: actor.game.rinshan
    - set:
        field: actor.game.rinshan
        value: false
    - set:
        field: state.kan_pending_dora
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: state.pending_kan
        value: null
    - call: _begin_responses
      params:
        seat: '{actor.seat}'
    - set:
        field: state.phase
        value: '"response"'
    - set:
        field: state.message
        value: actor.name + ' discarded ' + definitions.tiles[_tile].label + '.'
    - condition:
        condition: selected.op == 'riichi'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: state.message
            value: actor.name + ' declared riichi and discarded ' + definitions.tiles[_tile].label
              + '.'
        on_false: []
    narrative: {}
  _respond:
    description: Package-owned respond.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: selected
      type: object
      from_state: state.action_selection
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - condition:
        condition: selected.op == 'ron'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: state.ron_seats
            value: joined(state.ron_seats, one(actor.seat))
        on_false:
        - call: _waits
          params:
            actor: '{_actor_id}'
            tiles: '{actor.game.hand}'
          export_context:
            _waits: _waits
        - condition:
            condition: definitions.tiles[state.last_discard.tile].kind in _waits
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _completes
                value: true
            - condition:
                condition: state.phase == 'kan_response' and state.pending_kan.op
                  == 'ankan'
                on_true:
                - call: _score_hand
                  params:
                    actor: '{_actor_id}'
                    winning_tile: '{state.last_discard.tile}'
                    is_tsumo: false
                    win_source: closed_kan
                  export_context:
                    _score: _score
                - set:
                    field: _completes
                    value: _score.shape == 'orphans'
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _completes
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: actor.game.temporary_furiten
                    value: true
                - condition:
                    condition: actor.game.riichi
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: actor.game.riichi_furiten
                        value: true
                    on_false: []
                on_false: []
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: selected.op != 'pass'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _row
                value:
                  seat: actor.seat
            - set:
                field: state.pending_calls
                value: joined(state.pending_calls, one(merge(selected, _row)))
            on_false: []
    - set:
        field: state.responders
        value: portion(state.responders, 1, len(state.responders))
    - condition:
        condition: len(state.responders) > 0
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: state.actor
            value: state.responders[0]
        on_false:
        - call: _resolve_responses
          params: {}
    narrative: {}
  _resolve_responses:
    description: Package-owned resolve responses.
    parameters: []
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - condition:
        condition: len(state.ron_seats) > 0
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: state.winners
            value: state.ron_seats
        - set:
            field: state.win_tsumo
            value: false
        - set:
            field: state.winning_tile
            value: state.last_discard.tile
        - set:
            field: state.win_source
            value: '"discard"'
        - condition:
            condition: state.last_discard.rinshan == true
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: state.win_source
                value: '"rinshan_discard"'
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: state.phase == 'kan_response'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: state.win_source
                value: '"closed_kan"'
            - condition:
                condition: state.pending_kan.op == 'kakan'
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: state.win_source
                    value: '"added_kan"'
                on_false: []
            on_false: []
        - call: _settle_wins
          params: {}
        on_false:
        - condition:
            condition: state.phase == 'kan_response'
            on_true:
            - call: _commit_kan
              params: {}
            on_false:
            - condition:
                condition: state.pending_riichi != null
                on_true:
                - condition:
                    condition: 'true'
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _argument_actor
                        value: state.seats[state.pending_riichi]
                    - call: _accept_riichi
                      params:
                        actor: '{_argument_actor}'
                    on_false: []
                - set:
                    field: state.pending_riichi
                    value: null
                on_false: []
            - set:
                field: _chosen
                value: null
            - set:
                field: _calls
                value: state.pending_calls
            - for_each:
                collection: _calls
                as: _call
                do:
                - condition:
                    condition: _chosen == null or (_chosen.op == 'chi' and _call.op
                      != 'chi')
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _chosen
                        value: _call
                    on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _chosen != null
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: state.action_selection
                    value: _chosen
                - condition:
                    condition: 'true'
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _argument_actor
                        value: state.seats[_chosen.seat]
                    - call: _commit_call
                      params:
                        actor: '{_argument_actor}'
                    on_false: []
                on_false:
                - call: _abort_checks
                  params: {}
                  export_context:
                    _abort_reason: _abort_reason
                - condition:
                    condition: _abort_reason != null
                    on_true:
                    - call: _abort
                      params:
                        reason: '{_abort_reason}'
                    on_false:
                    - condition:
                        condition: len(state.live) == 0
                        on_true:
                        - call: _exhaustive
                          params: {}
                        on_false:
                        - set:
                            field: state.actor
                            value: state.seats[(state.last_discard.seat + 1) % 4]
                        - call: _draw
                          params:
                            actor: '{state.actor}'
                        - set:
                            field: state.message
                            value: '"Next seat drew a tile."'
    narrative: {}
  _accept_riichi:

      resolve: entity
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: actor.score
        value: actor.score - 1000
    - set:
        field: state.sticks
        value: state.sticks + 1
    - set:
        field: actor.game.riichi
        value: true
    - set:
        field: actor.game.ippatsu
        value: true
    narrative: {}
  _cancel_ippatsu:
    description: Package-owned cancel ippatsu.

    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: actor.game.ippatsu
        value: false
    narrative: {}
  _interrupt:

    pre_conditions: []
    effects:

        field: state.any_call
        value: true
    - set:
        field: _seats
        value: state.seats
    - for_each:
        collection: _seats
        as: _seat
        do:
        - call: _cancel_ippatsu
          params:
            actor: '{_seat}'
    narrative: {}
  _claim_discard:
    description: Package-owned claim discard.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _discards
        value: actor.game.discards
    - set:
        field: _index
        value: len(_discards) - 1
    - set:
        field: _last
        value: merge(_discards[_index], definitions.claimed_flag)
    - set:
        field: actor.game.discards
        value: replaced(_discards, _index, _last)
    narrative: {}
  _commit_call:
    description: Package-owned commit call.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: selected
      type: object
      from_state: state.action_selection
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - call: _interrupt
      params: {}
    - condition:
        condition: 'true'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _argument_actor
            value: state.seats[state.last_discard.seat]
        - call: _claim_discard
          params:
            actor: '{_argument_actor}'
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: actor.game.hand
        value: without(actor.game.hand, selected.tiles)
    - set:

  _pao_check:

      resolve: entity
    - name: source_seat

                - set:

    - condition:

        - set:
            field: actor.game.pao_dragon
            value: source_seat
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: _winds == 4 and actor.game.pao_wind == null

        - set:
            field: actor.game.pao_wind
            value: source_seat

    - name: selected

    - set:

    effects:

        field: _abort_reason
        value: null
    - set:
        field: _all_riichi
        value: true
    - set:
        field: _same_wind
        value: true
    - set:
        field: _wind
        value: -1

        field: _seats

    - for_each:

        - call: _abort_flags
          params:
            actor: '{_seat}'
          export_context:
            _riichi: _riichi
            _first_wind: _first_wind
        - condition:
            condition: not _riichi
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _all_riichi
                value: false
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _first_wind == -1 or (_wind != -1 and _wind != _first_wind)

            - set:

                value: false
            on_false: []
        - set:
            field: _wind
            value: _first_wind
    - condition:

  _pay_winner:
    description: Package-owned pay winner.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: award_sticks
      type: boolean
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - call: _score_hand
      params:
        actor: '{_actor_id}'
        winning_tile: '{state.winning_tile}'
        is_tsumo: '{state.win_tsumo}'
        win_source: '{state.win_source}'
      export_context:
        _score: _score
    - require:
        condition: _score.valid
        error: The winning hand has no legal yaku.
    - set:
        field: _payments
        value:
        - 0
        - 0
        - 0
        - 0
    - set:
        field: _ron_honba
        value: 0
    - condition:
        condition: award_sticks or definitions.profile.ron_honba == 'each_winner'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _ron_honba
            value: state.honba * 300
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _basic
        value: _score.basic
    - set:
        field: _pao
        value: []
    - condition:
        condition: _score.big_dragons and actor.game.pao_dragon != null
        on_true:
        - list_push:
            list: _pao
            value:
              seat: actor.game.pao_dragon
              basic: 8000
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: _score.big_winds and actor.game.pao_wind != null
        on_true:
        - list_push:
            list: _pao
            value:
              seat: actor.game.pao_wind
              basic: 16000
        on_false: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _pao
        as: _liability
        do:
        - set:
            field: _component
            value: _liability.basic * 4
        - condition:
            condition: actor.seat == state.dealer
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _component
                value: _liability.basic * 6
            on_false: []
        - set:
            field: _basic
            value: _basic - _liability.basic
        - condition:
            condition: state.win_tsumo or state.last_discard.seat == _liability.seat
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _payments
                value: replaced(_payments, _liability.seat, _payments[_liability.seat]
                  + _component)
            on_false:
            - set:
                field: _payments
                value: replaced(_payments, _liability.seat, _payments[_liability.seat]
                  + _component // 2)
            - set:
                field: _source
                value: state.last_discard.seat
            - set:
                field: _payments
                value: replaced(_payments, _source, _payments[_source] + _component
                  // 2)
    - condition:
        condition: state.win_tsumo
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _payers
            value: indices(4)
        - for_each:
            collection: _payers
            as: _payer
            do:
            - condition:
                condition: _payer != actor.seat
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _factor
                    value: 1
                - condition:
                    condition: actor.seat == state.dealer or _payer == state.dealer
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _factor
                        value: 2
                    on_false: []
                - set:
                    field: _payment
                    value: ((_basic * _factor + 99) // 100) * 100
                - set:
                    field: _honba
                    value: state.honba * 100
                - condition:
                    condition: len(_pao) > 0
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _honba
                        value: 0
                    - condition:
                        condition: _payer == _pao[0].seat
                        on_true:
                        - set:
                            field: _honba
                            value: state.honba * 300
                        on_false: []
                    on_false: []
                - set:
                    field: _payments
                    value: replaced(_payments, _payer, _payments[_payer] + _payment
                      + _honba)
                on_false: []
        on_false:
        - set:
            field: _factor
            value: 4
        - condition:
            condition: actor.seat == state.dealer
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _factor
                value: 6
            on_false: []
        - set:
            field: _source
            value: state.last_discard.seat
        - set:
            field: _payments
            value: replaced(_payments, _source, _payments[_source] + ((_basic * _factor
              + 99) // 100) * 100)
        - set:
            field: _honba_source
            value: _source
        - condition:
            condition: len(_pao) > 0
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _honba_source
                value: _pao[0].seat
            on_false: []
        - set:
            field: _payments
            value: replaced(_payments, _honba_source, _payments[_honba_source] + _ron_honba)
    - set:
        field: _payers
        value: indices(4)
    - for_each:
        collection: _payers
        as: _payer
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: _payments[_payer] > 0
            on_true:
            - condition:
                condition: 'true'
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _argument_actor
                    value: state.seats[_payer]
                - set:
                    field: _argument_amount
                    value: 0 - _payments[_payer]
                - call: _adjust_score
                  params:
                    actor: '{_argument_actor}'
                    amount: '{_argument_amount}'
                on_false: []
            on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _gain
        value: total(_payments)
    - condition:
        condition: award_sticks
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _gain
            value: _gain + state.sticks * 1000
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: actor.score
        value: actor.score + _gain
    - set:
        field: actor.game.revealed
        value: true
    - set:
        field: _winning_hand
        value: actor.game.hand
    - condition:
        condition: not state.win_tsumo
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _winning_hand
            value: joined(_winning_hand, one(state.winning_tile))
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _labels
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _winning_hand
        as: _tile
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _labels
            value: definitions.tiles[_tile].label
    - set:
        field: _win_result
        value:
          seat: actor.seat
          name: actor.name
          score: _score
          payments: _payments
          gain: _gain
          hand: _labels
    narrative: {}
  _draw_status:

  _exhaustive:
    description: Package-owned exhaustive.
    parameters: []
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _tenpai_seats
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _nagashi_seats
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _seats
        value: indices(4)
    - for_each:
        collection: _seats
        as: _seat
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: 'true'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _argument_actor
                value: state.seats[_seat]
            - call: _draw_status
              params:
                actor: '{_argument_actor}'
              export_context:
                _tenpai: _tenpai
                _nagashi: _nagashi
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _tenpai
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _tenpai_seats
                value: _seat
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _nagashi
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _nagashi_seats
                value: _seat
            on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _deltas
        value:
        - 0
        - 0
        - 0
        - 0
    - condition:
        condition: len(_nagashi_seats) > 0
        on_true:
        - for_each:
            collection: _nagashi_seats
            as: _winner
            do:
            - for_each:
                collection: _seats
                as: _payer
                do:
                - condition:
                    condition: _payer != _winner
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _amount
                        value: 2000
                    - condition:
                        condition: _winner == state.dealer or _payer == state.dealer
                        on_true:
                        - set:
                            field: _amount
                            value: 4000
                        on_false: []
                    - set:
                        field: _deltas
                        value: replaced(_deltas, _payer, _deltas[_payer] - _amount)
                    - set:
                        field: _deltas
                        value: replaced(_deltas, _winner, _deltas[_winner] + _amount)
                    on_false: []
        on_false:
        - condition:
            condition: len(_tenpai_seats) > 0 and len(_tenpai_seats) < 4
            on_true:
            - for_each:
                collection: _seats
                as: _seat
                do:
                - set:
                    field: _amount
                    value: 0 - 3000 // (4 - len(_tenpai_seats))
                - condition:
                    condition: _seat in _tenpai_seats
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _amount
                        value: 3000 // len(_tenpai_seats)
                    on_false: []
                - set:
                    field: _deltas
                    value: replaced(_deltas, _seat, _amount)
            on_false: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _seats
        as: _seat
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: 'true'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _argument_actor
                value: state.seats[_seat]
            - set:
                field: _argument_amount
                value: _deltas[_seat]
            - call: _adjust_score
              params:
                actor: '{_argument_actor}'
                amount: '{_argument_amount}'
            on_false: []
    - set:
        field: state.result
        value:
          kind: '"draw"'
          tenpai: _tenpai_seats
          nagashi: _nagashi_seats
          deltas: _deltas
          dealer_stays: state.dealer in _tenpai_seats
    - call: _end_hand
      params: {}
    - set:
        field: state.message
        value: '"Exhaustive draw. Scores settled."'
    narrative: {}

    - for_each:

        - set:

        - for_each:
            collection: _candidates
            as: _candidate
            do:
            - condition:
                condition: _candidate not in _picked
                on_true:
                - condition:
                    condition: _best == -1
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _best
                        value: _candidate
                    on_false:
                    - condition:
                        condition: _scores[_candidate] > _scores[_best]
                        on_true:
                        - set:
                            field: _best
                            value: _candidate
                        on_false: []
                on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: 'true'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _argument_actor
                value: state.seats[_best]
            - call: _standing
              params:
                actor: '{_argument_actor}'
              export_context:
                _score: _score
                _name: _name
            on_false: []
        - list_push:
            list: _standings
            value:
              rank: _rank + 1
              seat: _best
              name: _name
              points: _score
        - list_push:
            list: _picked
            value: _best
    - set:
        field: state.match_result
        value:
          winner: _standings[0].seat
          standings: _standings
          match_format: state.match_format

    description: Package-owned advance match.
    parameters: []
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _last_dealer
        value: state.dealer
    - set:
        field: _last_round
        value: state.round_wind
