        - call: _standing
          params:
            actor: '{_seat}'
          export_context:
            _score: _score
        - list_push:
            list: _scores
            value: _score
    - set:
        field: _top
        value: 0
    - set:
        field: _indexes
        value:
        - 1
        - 2
        - 3
    - for_each:
        collection: _indexes
        as: _index
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: _scores[_index] > _scores[_top]
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _top
                value: _index
            on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _nominal
        value: 0
    - condition:
        condition: state.match_format == 'east_south'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _nominal
            value: 1
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _dealer_ron_priority
        value: state.result.kind == 'win' and state.result.dealer_stays and state.result.winners
          != null and len(state.result.winners) > 1
    - set:
        field: _finished
        value: min(_scores[0], _scores[1], _scores[2], _scores[3]) < 0
    - condition:
        condition: state.round_wind > _nominal and _scores[_top] >= 30000 and not
          _dealer_ron_priority
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _finished
            value: true
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: state.round_wind >= _nominal and state.dealer == 3 and _top ==
          3 and _scores[3] >= 30000 and state.result.dealer_stays and state.result.kind
          != 'abort'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _finished
            value: true
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: not state.result.dealer_stays
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: state.dealer
            value: state.dealer + 1
        - condition:
            condition: state.dealer == 4
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: state.dealer
                value: 0
            - set:
                field: state.round_wind
                value: state.round_wind + 1
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: state.result.kind == 'win'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: state.honba
                value: 0
            on_false:
            - set:
                field: state.honba
                value: state.honba + 1
        on_false:
        - set:
            field: state.honba
            value: state.honba + 1
    - condition:
        condition: state.round_wind > _nominal and _scores[_top] >= 30000 and not
          _dealer_ron_priority
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _finished
            value: true
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: state.round_wind > _nominal + 1
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _finished
            value: true
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: _finished
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: state.dealer
            value: _last_dealer
        - set:
            field: state.round_wind
            value: _last_round
        - set:
            field: state.honba
            value: _last_honba
        - condition:
            condition: 'true'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _argument_actor
                value: state.seats[_top]
            - set:
                field: _argument_amount
                value: state.sticks * 1000
            - call: _adjust_score

                actor: '{_argument_actor}'
                amount: '{_argument_amount}'
            on_false: []
        - set:
            field: state.sticks
            value: 0
        - set:
            field: state.finished
            value: true
        - set:
            field: state.phase
            value: '"finished"'
        - call: _rank_match
          params: {}
        - set:
            field: state.message
            value: '"Match complete. Ties follow original seat order."'
        on_false:
        - call: _new_hand
          params: {}
        - set:
            field: state.message
            value: '"Next hand dealt."'

            field: state.winners
            value: one(actor.seat)
        - set:
            field: state.win_tsumo

          params:
            reason: Nine terminals
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: _selected.op == 'continue'
        on_true:
        - call: _advance_match
          params: {}
        on_false: []
    - call: _refresh
      params: {}
    - publish:
        fields:
          message: state.message
          result: state.result
          match_result: state.match_result
    narrative: {}
    metadata:
      model_behavior: resolves_player_intent
      player_controls:
        confirmation: none
        response: automatic

        - condition: choice in state.choice_ids

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
skills:
  - name: Intrusion
    description: Enter or reshape a hostile signal environment.
  - name: Field Medicine
    description: Stabilize an operator under pressure.
model_decision_boundary:
  active_actor: {namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static, key: state.active_actor}
  actor_entities: {namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static, key: state.entities}
  participant_control:
    field: control_owner
    player_values: [player]
  default_owner: gm
tools:
  commit_program:
    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
      - name: program
        type: string
        required: true
      - name: amount
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        required: true
      - name: charge_cost
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        required: true
      - name: multiplier
        type: integer
        required: true
      - name: family
        type: enum
        enum_values:
          - add_stress
          - clear_interference
        required: true
    effects:
      - decrement:
          field: state.resources.charge
          amount: charge_cost
      - set:
          field: state.last_program.name
          value: program
      - set:
          field: state.last_program.result
          value: amount * multiplier
      - condition: family == 'clear_interference'
        on_true:
          - set:
              field: state.conditions.interference
              value: false
      - condition: family == 'add_stress'
        on_true:
          - increment:
              field: state.stress
              amount: 1
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters:
      - name: skill
        type: enum
        enum_values:
          - intrusion
          - field_medicine
      - name: pressure
        type: integer
        required: true
    effects:
      - dice:
          expression: 2d6
        store_as: _operation_roll
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.skill
          value: skill
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.total
          value: _operation_roll.total
      - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
        on_true:
          - set:
              field: state.last_check.outcome
              value: clear
        on_false:
          - set:
              field: state.last_check.outcome
              value: compromised
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
      - name: stress
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        required: true
      - name: wounds
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        required: true
      - name: charge_spent
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        required: true
      - name: progress
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        required: true
    effects:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: stress
      - increment:
          field: state.wounds
          amount: wounds
      - decrement:
          field: state.resources.charge
          amount: charge_spent
      - set:
          field: state.conditions.interference
          value: true
      - increment:
          field: state.advancement.intrusion
          amount: progress
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
      - name: program
        type: enum
        enum_values:
          - ghost_route
          - signal_boost
        required: true
      - name: amount
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        required: true
    effects:
      - table_lookup:
          table: definitions.programs
          key: program
          required: true
          exact_selector: true
        store_as: _definition
      - set:
          field: _definition_key
          value: program
      - set:
          field: _definition_table
          value: programs
      - call: commit_program
        params:
          program: "{program}"
          amount: "{amount}"
          charge_cost: "{_definition.charge_cost}"
          multiplier: "{_definition.multiplier}"
          family: "{_definition.family}"
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
